Maria (Growth): Quick pulse — noticed LP -> lead conversion dipped Tues AM but webinar signups are +2.3x. Dash shows big shift to 'direct' for inbound attribution. Anyone else seeing mismatch?
Jake (Data): Looking now. GA session source shows paid_search down, organic up. CRM has many signups as 'direct' — feels like UTMs dropped. Pulling logs.
Anya (Product Mktg): Did we change any redirects or canonicalization on the launch post? I pushed a tiny slash normalization last night.
Sam (Growth Ops): I rolled an nginx redirect tweak at 01:14 UTC to normalize trailing slashes — could that strip query params? @Jake can you confirm quickly?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Redirects update deployed by @Sam at 2026-03-23T01:14Z.
Jake (Data): Confirmed in deploy logs — the rule replaced `^/(.*)$` with `/$1` and the proxy config didn't preserve querystring. Example from edge logs: `10.2.3.4 - - "GET /lp?utm_source=paid HTTP/1.1"` proxied to `/lp` (no query).
Maria (Growth): Oof. That explains the sudden migration to 'direct'. Impact estimate?
Jake (Data): Rough estimate: ~2.1k sessions affected, ~420 leads misattributed over the last 48h. Webinar signups +200 in that cohort specifically.
Anya (Product Mktg): Can we backfill attribution for reporting? I'd like those flagged as paid_search for funnel metrics.
Sam (Growth Ops): We can backfill server-side using referrer + session cookies where available. I'll make a ticket and scope.
Sam (Growth Ops): Created ticket MK-1294 and linked to ops runbook for backfill + rollback.
Maria (Growth): For this week's KPI review: show raw dashboard and corrected/backfilled numbers, and flag as a known attribution incident.
Jake (Data): I'll add a supplemental sheet with the SQL and steps. SQL example for backfill: `UPDATE leads SET source='paid_search' WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-22' AND ref LIKE '%google%' AND source='direct';` (will refine before running).
Anya (Product Mktg): Also need to check landing copy variant performance — if UTMs were lost some variants may look artificially better/worse. @Maria can you pull variant breakdown?
Maria (Growth): On it — I'll include variant/treatment breakdown in the weekly deck. Also recommend a short blurb in webinar follow-up noting signup attribution anomalies.
Sam (Growth Ops): Rolled previous redirect logic back at 01:43Z. UTMs preserved again.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback applied by @Sam at 2026-03-23T01:43Z — querystrings preserved.
Jake (Data): I'll run the backfill tonight and post numbers here.
Maria (Growth): Thanks. For the KPI review agenda: include raw vs corrected dashboard, lead delta, CPA change, and webinar cohort behavior. Call out the incident in notes.
Anya (Product Mktg): :thumbsup: I'll update slides to include a 'known attribution bug' callout and the timeline.
Sam (Growth Ops): Adding incident entry to marketing notes and MK-1294.
Jake (Data): Posting initial backfill summary in thread: corrected +410 leads attributed to paid_search, CPA for paid_search lowered ~7% after correction. Detailed sheet: https://redwood-internal.example/sheets/mk-backfill-2026
Maria (Growth): Perfect. We'll highlight this at Monday's KPI review and tie to the webinar postmortem. Closing loop for now — thanks team.
